Bhagavad Gita, Chapter 5, Verse 29

“Knowing me as the enjoyer of sacrifices and austerities, the great Lord of all the worlds, and the friend of every being, one attains peace.”

The chapter ends on suhrit, well-wisher. After all the metaphysics, Krishna's final word about himself is the most personal one — not ruler but friend, of everyone.
